description: This file defines the Sugarpdf class, a subclass of TCPDF, tailored to generate PDF documents within the SuiteCRM project. It includes constants for stretch options, properties for module/view context, and methods for initializing PDF settings, rendering headers, and creating formatted tables in PDF format.

classes.name: Sugarpdf
classes.description: A custom PDF generation class extending TCPDF, providing application-specific header, footer, and table rendering functionalities, with added constants and properties for SuiteCRM context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Sugarpdf object with module, bean context, and configuration settings.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Coordinates the PDF generation process by calling preDisplay and display.

methods.name: displayErrors
methods.description: Outputs any error messages stored in the errors array.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Sets up PDF document information and layout properties before content is added.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Default implementation for adding content to the PDF; designed to be overridden.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Custom header rendering, displaying logo and header titles.

methods.name: SetFont
methods.description: Overrides TCPDF's SetFont to support custom font directories.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Outputs debug information about the class, module, action, and bean.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Overrides Cell to encode and decode strings for correct PDF rendering.

methods.name: Ln1
methods.description: Prints a line break of a fixed height.

methods.name: writeCellTable
methods.description: Creates a formatted table using MultiCell with flexible options for headers and data rows.

methods.name: writeHTMLTable
methods.description: Generates an HTML table from data array and inserts into the PDF.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Helper to wrap content in HTML tags with options.

methods.name: getLineHeightFromArray
methods.description: Calculates line height based on cell content and width.

methods.name: initOptionsForWriteCellTable
methods.description: Initializes and normalizes options for table cell rendering.

methods.name: getNumLines
methods.description: Estimates number of lines needed for a text block within a given width.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Overrides TCPDF's Output to disable zlib compression during download.
